title: Application API Response Slow
description: Application APIs are taking too much time to respond due to slow database queries.
resolution: Analyzed slow SQL queries, added appropriate database indexes and optimized frequently executed queries.

title: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion
description: Application is unable to connect to the database because all available connections are occupied.
resolution: Reviewed connection pool configuration, increased pool capacity appropriately and fixed connections not being released.

title: Application High CPU Usage
description: Server CPU utilization is continuously high and application performance is degraded.
resolution: Analyzed thread activity, identified CPU intensive operations and optimized the application code.

title: OutOfMemoryError in Application
description: Java application crashes frequently because JVM memory usage reaches the configured heap limit.
resolution: Analyzed heap dumps, identified memory leaks and optimized object allocation and memory management.

title: Application Login Failure
description: Users are unable to log into the application because authentication requests are failing.
resolution: Reviewed authentication logs, corrected security configuration and verified user credential validation.

title: REST API Returns HTTP 500
description: REST API requests intermittently fail with internal server error responses.
resolution: Analyzed application logs, identified an unhandled exception and added appropriate exception handling.

title: File Upload Failure
description: Users cannot upload documents because file upload requests fail with size limit errors.
resolution: Reviewed multipart configuration and increased the maximum permitted file size.

title: Database Query Timeout
description: Database queries take too long and eventually fail with query timeout exceptions.
resolution: Analyzed execution plans, optimized SQL queries and reviewed database indexing.

title: Application Server Not Starting
description: Spring Boot application fails to start because the configured server port is already occupied.
resolution: Identified the process using the configured port and changed the application server port.

title: NullPointerException in API
description: REST API throws NullPointerException when processing requests containing missing values.
resolution: Identified the null object reference, added input validation and handled missing values safely.

title: Angular API Integration Failure
description: Angular frontend cannot communicate with Spring Boot backend because browser requests are blocked by CORS.
resolution: Configured appropriate CORS origins and HTTP methods in the Spring Boot application.

title: Scheduled Job Not Executing
description: Scheduled background tasks are not executing at the expected time in the application.
resolution: Reviewed scheduler configuration, verified scheduling annotations and corrected the cron expression.

title: JVM Garbage Collection Overhead
description: Application experiences frequent garbage collection cycles, resulting in high response times and degraded performance.
resolution: Analyzed GC logs, reviewed heap allocation patterns, optimized object creation and adjusted JVM garbage collection settings.

title: Java Thread Deadlock
description: Application threads are blocked indefinitely while waiting for locks held by other threads.
resolution: Captured thread dumps, identified circular lock dependencies and corrected synchronization logic to prevent deadlocks.

title: Thread Pool Exhaustion
description: Application cannot process incoming requests because all worker threads are occupied by long-running tasks.
resolution: Analyzed thread pool utilization, identified blocking operations and optimized thread pool sizing and task execution.

title: Memory Leak in Java Application
description: Application memory consumption continuously increases over time even when traffic remains stable.
resolution: Analyzed heap dumps using memory profiling tools, identified objects retained unnecessarily and fixed resource cleanup and object references.

title: StackOverflowError
description: Application crashes with StackOverflowError because of excessive recursive method calls.
resolution: Analyzed the stack trace, identified infinite or excessive recursion and corrected the termination condition.

title: ClassNotFoundException
description: Application fails to execute because a required Java class is missing from the runtime classpath.
resolution: Reviewed dependency configuration, verified packaged JAR contents and added the missing dependency.

title: NoClassDefFoundError
description: Application fails at runtime because a required class could not be loaded or initialized.
resolution: Reviewed runtime dependencies, investigated class initialization failures and corrected classpath and packaging issues.

title: Spring Bean Creation Failure
description: Spring Boot application fails during startup because a required bean cannot be created or injected.
resolution: Reviewed dependency injection configuration, component scanning, bean definitions and constructor dependencies.

title: Circular Dependency Between Spring Beans
description: Application startup fails because two or more Spring components depend on each other.
resolution: Reviewed the dependency structure and refactored responsibilities to eliminate circular dependencies.

title: Spring Boot Configuration Failure
description: Application fails to start because required environment properties or configuration values are missing.
resolution: Validated application properties, environment variables and active Spring profiles, then corrected the missing configuration.

title: Spring Transaction Rollback Failure
description: Database operations partially execute or fail to roll back when an exception occurs during transaction processing.
resolution: Reviewed transaction boundaries, propagation settings and rollback rules, and corrected transaction management.

title: JPA LazyInitializationException
description: Application throws LazyInitializationException when accessing lazy-loaded entity relationships outside an active Hibernate session.
resolution: Reviewed transaction boundaries and entity fetching strategies, and used appropriate fetch joins or DTO projections.

title: Hibernate N+1 Query Problem
description: Application executes excessive database queries when retrieving entities with associated relationships.
resolution: Analyzed SQL execution logs and optimized entity fetching using fetch joins, entity graphs or batch fetching.

title: Database Deadlock
description: Multiple database transactions block each other while acquiring locks on shared records.
resolution: Analyzed database deadlock graphs, optimized transaction ordering and reduced lock duration.

title: Database Transaction Blocking
description: Database queries remain blocked because another transaction holds locks on required database resources.
resolution: Identified blocking sessions, analyzed long-running transactions and optimized transaction execution.

title: Database Disk Space Exhaustion
description: Database operations fail because the database storage or transaction log has reached its configured capacity.
resolution: Reviewed database storage utilization, expanded available capacity and implemented transaction log and data retention maintenance.

title: Database Authentication Failure
description: Application cannot establish a database connection because the configured database credentials are invalid or expired.
resolution: Verified database credentials, login permissions and secret configuration, then updated the application connection settings.

title: Database Schema Mismatch
description: Application fails because the deployed database schema does not match the entity mappings or expected application version.
resolution: Compared application entity mappings with the database schema and applied the required migration scripts.

title: Database Replication Lag
description: Read replicas return outdated data because database replication is delayed.
resolution: Monitored replication lag, investigated replication bottlenecks and routed consistency-sensitive operations to the primary database.

title: SQL Constraint Violation
description: Database insert or update operations fail because of primary key, foreign key or unique constraint violations.
resolution: Analyzed the failing SQL operation, validated input data and corrected entity relationships and duplicate record handling.

title: SQL Server TempDB Exhaustion
description: SQL Server queries fail or slow down because TempDB resources are exhausted or heavily contended.
resolution: Reviewed TempDB utilization, identified resource-intensive queries and optimized temporary object usage and TempDB configuration.

title: REST API Rate Limit Exceeded
description: API requests are rejected because clients exceed the configured request rate limit.
resolution: Reviewed API traffic patterns, configured appropriate rate limits and implemented retry handling with exponential backoff.

title: API Gateway Timeout
description: API gateway returns timeout responses because downstream services take longer than the configured timeout.
resolution: Analyzed downstream response times, optimized slow operations and reviewed gateway and service timeout configurations.

title: Microservice Communication Failure
description: One microservice cannot communicate with another because the downstream service is unavailable or unreachable.
resolution: Analyzed service connectivity, verified endpoint configuration and implemented appropriate timeouts, retries and circuit breakers.

title: Circuit Breaker Continuously Open
description: Microservice requests are rejected because the circuit breaker remains open after repeated downstream failures.
resolution: Reviewed failure thresholds, investigated downstream service health and corrected circuit breaker recovery configuration.

title: Duplicate API Request Processing
description: The same business transaction is processed multiple times because clients or infrastructure retry requests.
resolution: Implemented idempotency keys, duplicate request detection and appropriate transaction handling.

title: API Response Serialization Failure
description: REST API responses fail because Java objects contain unsupported types, circular references or serialization errors.
resolution: Reviewed DTO structures, Jackson configuration and entity relationships, and corrected serialization issues.

title: API Request Payload Validation Failure
description: API requests fail because incoming payloads contain missing, invalid or incorrectly formatted fields.
resolution: Implemented request DTO validation using Bean Validation annotations and returned meaningful validation error responses.

title: JWT Token Expiration Failure
description: Authenticated API requests fail because access tokens expire before clients refresh or renew them.
resolution: Reviewed token expiration settings and implemented secure token refresh and re-authentication handling.

title: Unauthorized API Access
description: Users receive HTTP 401 or 403 responses when accessing APIs because authentication or authorization configuration is incorrect.
resolution: Reviewed security filters, JWT validation, user roles and endpoint authorization rules.

title: SQL Injection Vulnerability
description: Application is vulnerable to SQL injection because user input is directly concatenated into database queries.
resolution: Replaced dynamic query concatenation with parameterized queries or prepared statements and validated incoming inputs.

title: Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability
description: Application may execute malicious scripts because untrusted user input is rendered without appropriate sanitization.
resolution: Applied context-aware output encoding, input validation and secure frontend rendering practices.

title: Cross-Site Request Forgery
description: Application accepts unauthorized state-changing requests because CSRF protection is incorrectly configured.
resolution: Reviewed CSRF protection, configured appropriate security tokens and validated cookie SameSite settings.

title: Angular Application Blank Screen
description: Users see a blank screen because the Angular application fails during initialization or encounters a runtime exception.
resolution: Reviewed browser console errors, application bootstrap configuration and module dependencies, then fixed the initialization failure.

title: Angular Memory Leak
description: Angular application memory usage increases because subscriptions, event listeners or timers are not properly cleaned up.
resolution: Reviewed component lifecycle management and implemented subscription cleanup using takeUntilDestroyed or appropriate unsubscribe mechanisms.

title: Angular Application Slow Loading
description: Frontend application takes too long to load because of large bundles, unnecessary dependencies or inefficient component loading.
resolution: Analyzed bundle sizes, implemented lazy loading, optimized imports and enabled appropriate production build optimizations.

title: Angular HTTP Request Failure
description: Frontend API calls fail because of incorrect endpoint configuration, network errors or backend unavailability.
resolution: Reviewed browser network logs, API base URLs, HTTP interceptors and backend connectivity.

title: Angular Route Navigation Failure
description: Users cannot navigate to certain application pages because route definitions, guards or lazy-loaded modules are incorrectly configured.
resolution: Reviewed Angular router configuration, route guards, module loading and route parameter handling.

title: Angular Build Compilation Failure
description: Frontend deployment fails because Angular compilation encounters TypeScript errors, dependency conflicts or invalid build configuration.
resolution: Analyzed build logs, corrected TypeScript errors and resolved dependency and Angular configuration conflicts.

title: Browser Caching Serves Old Application
description: Users continue seeing an outdated frontend version after a new application deployment.
resolution: Reviewed browser and CDN cache policies, configured asset fingerprinting and corrected index.html cache headers.

title: Static Resource Loading Failure
description: Application fails to load CSS, JavaScript, images or other static resources because resource paths or server mappings are incorrect.
resolution: Verified resource paths, reverse proxy mappings and static resource serving configuration.

title: File Upload Storage Failure
description: File uploads fail because the application server cannot access the configured storage location or lacks write permissions.
resolution: Verified storage availability, filesystem permissions, mount configuration and upload directory capacity.

title: Email Notification Failure
description: Application fails to send email notifications because the SMTP server is unavailable or email configuration is incorrect.
resolution: Verified SMTP host, port, authentication and TLS configuration, and reviewed mail server connectivity and logs.

title: Message Queue Consumer Failure
description: Background messages are not processed because message consumers have stopped or cannot connect to the messaging broker.
resolution: Reviewed consumer logs, broker connectivity, consumer group configuration and message processing exceptions.

title: Message Queue Backlog
description: Messages accumulate in the queue because consumers cannot process incoming messages at the required rate.
resolution: Analyzed consumer throughput, optimized message processing and scaled consumer instances appropriately.

title: Duplicate Message Processing
description: The same message is processed multiple times because of message redelivery or consumer failures.
resolution: Implemented idempotent message processing, unique message identifiers and safe transaction handling.

title: Scheduled Job Executed Multiple Times
description: A scheduled task runs multiple times because multiple application instances execute the same scheduled operation.
resolution: Implemented distributed scheduling coordination or a distributed lock to ensure only one instance executes the job.

title: Cache Data Inconsistency
description: Application returns outdated or inconsistent data because cached values are not refreshed after database updates.
resolution: Reviewed cache invalidation strategies, implemented appropriate TTL policies and synchronized cache updates with database changes.

title: Redis Connection Failure
description: Application cannot retrieve cached data because the Redis server is unavailable or connection configuration is incorrect.
resolution: Verified Redis connectivity, authentication, network access and connection pool configuration, and implemented fallback handling.

title: Application Deployment Failure
description: New application deployment fails because of incorrect artifact configuration, missing dependencies or environment-specific issues.
resolution: Reviewed deployment logs, verified artifact integrity, environment variables and dependency compatibility before redeployment.

title: Application Rollback Failure
description: Application cannot return to the previous stable version because the rollback process or deployment artifacts are unavailable.
resolution: Maintained versioned deployment artifacts, validated rollback procedures and ensured backward-compatible database changes.

title: CI/CD Pipeline Failure
description: Automated build and deployment pipeline fails during compilation, testing, artifact creation or deployment.
resolution: Analyzed pipeline execution logs, corrected build configuration and dependency issues, and validated each deployment stage.

title: Environment Configuration Mismatch
description: Application behaves differently across development, testing and production environments because configurations are inconsistent.
resolution: Compared environment-specific configuration, standardized externalized properties and validated deployment variables.

title: SSL Certificate Expiration
description: Users cannot securely access the application because the HTTPS certificate has expired.
resolution: Renewed the SSL certificate, verified the certificate chain and configured automated expiration monitoring.

title: DNS Resolution Failure
description: Application cannot connect to dependent services because configured hostnames cannot be resolved.
resolution: Verified DNS records, resolver configuration and network connectivity, then corrected hostname resolution.

title: Firewall Blocking Application Traffic
description: Application cannot communicate with external services because firewall rules block required ports or network traffic.
resolution: Reviewed firewall policies, identified blocked connections and requested appropriate network access for required endpoints.

title: Load Balancer Health Check Failure
description: Application instances are removed from the load balancer because health check requests fail.
resolution: Reviewed health check endpoints, readiness conditions, timeout configuration and application startup status.

title: Reverse Proxy Configuration Failure
description: Users cannot access application APIs or frontend routes because reverse proxy forwarding rules are incorrect.
resolution: Reviewed proxy configuration, upstream server addresses, path rewriting and forwarded headers.

title: Container Startup Failure
description: Application container repeatedly exits because of incorrect startup commands, missing configuration or runtime dependency failures.
resolution: Reviewed container logs, entrypoint commands, environment variables and image dependencies, then corrected the container configuration.

title: Kubernetes Pod CrashLoopBackOff
description: Kubernetes application pods repeatedly restart because the application crashes or fails its startup checks.
resolution: Reviewed pod events and container logs, corrected application startup issues and validated resource and probe configuration.

title: Kubernetes Pod Out Of Memory
description: Kubernetes terminates application containers because memory consumption exceeds configured container limits.
resolution: Reviewed memory utilization and JVM heap settings, identified excessive memory usage and adjusted resource requests and limits appropriately.

title: Kubernetes Service Connectivity Failure
description: Application pods cannot communicate through Kubernetes Services because selectors, ports or networking configuration are incorrect.
resolution: Verified service selectors, pod labels, target ports, endpoints and cluster networking configuration.

title: Kubernetes ImagePullBackOff
description: Kubernetes cannot start a pod because the required container image cannot be downloaded from the configured registry.
resolution: Verified image name, image tag, registry availability and image pull secrets, then corrected the deployment configuration.

title: Kubernetes Configuration Not Applied
description: Application continues using outdated configuration because Kubernetes ConfigMap or Secret updates are not reflected in running pods.
resolution: Verified ConfigMap and Secret references, reviewed application reload behavior and restarted or rolled out workloads when required.

title: Application Logging Failure
description: Production application logs are missing or incomplete because of incorrect logging configuration or file permission issues.
resolution: Reviewed logging framework configuration, log levels, file permissions and log output destinations.

title: Log File Disk Exhaustion
description: Application server runs out of disk space because log files continuously grow without proper rotation or retention.
resolution: Configured log rotation, retention policies and appropriate logging levels, and cleaned up obsolete log files.

title: Monitoring Metrics Not Available
description: Operations teams cannot monitor application health because metrics are missing from the monitoring platform.
resolution: Verified metrics endpoints, monitoring agent configuration, scrape targets and application instrumentation.

title: Distributed Tracing Failure
description: Operations teams cannot trace requests across microservices because distributed tracing information is missing or incorrectly propagated.
resolution: Verified trace instrumentation, correlation identifiers, context propagation and tracing collector connectivity.

title: Production Application Unavailable
description: Users cannot access the application because the application server is down or critical dependencies are unavailable.
resolution: Checked application health, server availability, dependency connectivity and infrastructure logs, then restored the affected services.

title: Unexpected Application Restart
description: Application instances restart unexpectedly because of process termination, resource exhaustion or infrastructure failures.
resolution: Reviewed system logs, JVM crash reports, container events and resource utilization to identify the restart trigger.

title: High Network Latency
description: Application requests experience increased response times because of network congestion or slow communication between services.
resolution: Analyzed network latency, packet loss and connection paths, then coordinated infrastructure optimization.

title: External Third Party API Failure
description: Application functionality is disrupted because an external third-party API is unavailable or returning unexpected responses.
resolution: Reviewed external API status and response codes, implemented timeout and retry policies with circuit breakers, and provided fallback behavior.

title: Production Data Corruption
description: Application records contain inconsistent or corrupted values because of failed transactions, incorrect updates or data processing defects.
resolution: Identified affected records, investigated transaction and audit logs, restored valid data from verified backups where necessary and corrected the underlying defect.

title: Backup Job Failure
description: Scheduled database or application backups fail because of storage problems, permissions or backup configuration errors.
resolution: Reviewed backup execution logs, storage availability and permissions, corrected backup configuration and verified backup restoration.

title: Disaster Recovery Failure
description: Application services cannot be restored within the expected recovery time after a major infrastructure or data center failure.
resolution: Reviewed disaster recovery procedures, validated backup integrity, tested failover mechanisms and updated recovery documentation.

title: Production Performance Degradation After Deployment
description: Application response times increase significantly after a new release because of code changes, inefficient queries or configuration differences.
resolution: Compared application metrics before and after deployment, identified the regression and optimized or rolled back the affected changes.

title: API Version Compatibility Failure
description: Existing clients fail after an API update because request or response contracts have changed unexpectedly.
resolution: Reviewed API contract changes, introduced backward-compatible versioning and validated integration with existing clients.

title: Time Zone and Date Processing Error
description: Application displays incorrect timestamps or processes scheduled operations at unexpected times because of timezone conversion issues.
resolution: Standardized date storage using UTC, reviewed timezone conversions and corrected application and scheduler timezone configuration.

title: Production Secrets Exposure
description: Sensitive credentials or API keys are exposed through application logs, configuration files or source control.
resolution: Revoked exposed credentials, rotated secrets, removed sensitive values from logs and repositories, and implemented secure secret management.

title: Dependency Vulnerability Detected
description: Security scanning identifies vulnerable third-party libraries in the application dependencies.
resolution: Reviewed vulnerability reports, upgraded affected dependencies to secure compatible versions and reran security scans and regression tests.

title: Insufficient Application Audit Logging
description: Security and operations teams cannot determine who performed sensitive actions because application audit events are missing.
resolution: Implemented structured audit logging for sensitive operations, including user identity, timestamp, action and relevant transaction identifiers.

title: Connection Reset During API Communication
description: API requests fail intermittently because network connections are unexpectedly closed by clients, servers or intermediate network components.
resolution: Reviewed connection timeout settings, keep-alive configuration, proxy behavior and network logs, then corrected connection management.

title: Production Deployment Database Migration Failure
description: Application deployment fails because database migration scripts encounter schema conflicts, locking issues or incompatible changes.
resolution: Reviewed migration history and scripts, validated schema compatibility, tested migrations in staging and applied a controlled recovery plan.
